assets.name: conuo-cover
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: editorial cover illustration for a technical blog article about Conuo, an AI-assisted reading and learning workspace.
Primary request: Create a refined, tactile illustration about reading original source material, checking an AI explanation against it, and retaining one's understanding as reviewed notes. This is a conceptual cover, not a screenshot or a product interface.
Composition: exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels, landscape 3:2. Three related paper objects arranged with a clear quiet hierarchy: an open document with an abstract plotted curve and a highlighted paragraph, a translucent explanation sheet beside it, and a small stack of annotated note cards. Fine restrained connector lines visually join a highlighted source area to the explanation and then the notes. Preserve generous margins; all subjects fully within the canvas. Strong thumbnail readability.
Style/medium: sophisticated editorial paper sculpture and subtle 3D illustration, warm ivory paper, muted sage green, peach annotation accents, graphite lines, soft daylight and real shallow shadows, understated tactile grain. Not a generic futuristic AI image.
Constraints: no readable text anywhere, no letters or numbers, no logo, no watermark, no person, no brain, no robot, no laptop, no glowing circuitry. Marks on paper are abstract diagram strokes and non-readable typographic lines only. Do not invent a fake Conuo UI. No composition cropping.

brandEdit.prompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: Conuo technical-blog cover, exactly 1536x1024 pixels, landscape 3:2.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the warm ivory and sage editorial illustration with an open source book, translucent explanation sheet, connected study-note cards and a pencil.
Input image 2 is a supporting insert: the actual Conuo app logo, a violet rounded-square icon with the white folded abstract mark. Use this exact product logo and preserve its identity, shape, violet-white color and rounded corners.
Primary request: Add one clean Conuo brand mark as a small flat editorial overlay in the upper-left corner, inset about 46 pixels from the top and left, about 128x128 pixels. It should read as a deliberate product identifier, not an object on the desk. The overlay may cover only the small decorative plant/background area in that corner; it must not cover the book, diagrams, explanation sheet, connector lines or notes.
Invariants: all original imagery, camera angle, objects, textures, diagram strokes, lighting and colors remain unchanged. No readable text is added. Preserve transparency around the logo's rounded square; do not add a black rectangle, white backing card, border or extra shadow.
Constraints: no personal avatar, no peach cat, no other logos, no additional watermark, no extra words, no cropped image, no new scene objects. Keep 1536x1024. Only the finished edited cover.

assets.name: conuo-workflow-en
assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: a finished English conceptual workflow illustration for the Conuo engineering blog, exactly 1536x1024 pixels, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: Explain how original reading material, source-scoped AI questions, checking citations and human-reviewed notes connect. This must be an accurate workflow diagram, not a fake interface.
Style: clean warm-white editorial sheet, large legible graphite sans-serif labels, muted sage-green arrows, restrained peach source highlights, simple paper-document icons, subtle shallow dimension, generous spacing and margins. Visually related to the accompanying tactile book-and-note cover, but flat enough to read.
Title, top: "CONUO"
Subtitle: "FROM ORIGINAL SOURCES TO REVIEWED NOTES"
Four equal, spacious cards in one left-to-right row, each with its own small line icon and exactly these labels:
Card 1: heading "Original sources"; smaller line "Import & allow AI use".
Card 2: heading "Ask AI"; smaller line "Choose source scope".
Card 3: heading "Check citations"; smaller line "Open the cited original".
Card 4: heading "Notes & drafts"; smaller line "Edit notes / review drafts".
Exactly three directional arrows connect card 1 to 2, 2 to 3, and 3 to 4. Arrowheads point right.
Two wide explanatory panels below the row, aligned neatly and without cross-wiring:
Panel left: heading "Source boundaries"; body "File + version + location".
Panel right: heading "Human review"; body "Accept / edit / ignore AI drafts".
A quiet footer, exact text: "Conceptual workflow" and "Cloud save requires confirmation".
Constraints: Render only the exact English wording specified above, no extra text, no Chinese, no repeated headings, no unreadable filler, no logo, no checkmark, no success or automatic approval badge, no model icons, no robot, no brain, no watermark. Do not imply drafts are automatically accepted. Entire diagram must fit within the canvas, readable at blog width, no cropped edge text.

brandEdit.prompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: English Conuo blog workflow diagram, exactly 1536x1024 pixels.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the completed English workflow diagram.
Input image 2 is a supporting insert: the actual Conuo application logo, a violet rounded-square icon with a white folded abstract mark. Use that exact logo; do not redesign it.
Primary request: Add the real Conuo logo to the main title group at the top. Make the square logo about 90 pixels tall, immediately to the left of the existing "CONUO" wordmark with about 22 pixels of spacing. Center the combined logo-and-wordmark group on the canvas. Preserve the existing wordmark font, weight and height; move that wordmark horizontally only as needed to center the combined group.
Invariants: preserve all four workflow cards, both explanatory panels, every other label and spelling, all three right-pointing green arrows, document icons, background, colors, margins, geometry and footer unchanged. Do not replace workflow icons with logos. Do not recolor the violet logo to green; retain its violet and white identity and rounded corners, with transparency outside the square rather than a black rectangle.
Text: every existing English label must remain verbatim and fully readable. Add no text. Keep "CONUO" uppercase and the subtitle "FROM ORIGINAL SOURCES TO REVIEWED NOTES".
Avoid: personal avatars, peach cats, other brands, additional watermarks, new labels, changed arrows, automatic approval badges. Only the finished edited diagram.
